**Reasoning:**
This clearly shows a root/crown disease. The dark brown discoloration at the crown combined with pale, necrotic root tips is highly characteristic of **Rhizoctonia Damping-Off** in wheat. Rhizoctonia solani causes subcrown internode and root rot with these exact brownish lesions at root tips and crown regions. The image matches Bugwood reference 5626239, which is a classic Rhizoctonia root rot diagnostic image.

Other root diseases (Eyespot affects stem base with eye-shaped lesions; Cephalosporium Stripe shows vascular striping on leaves) don't match this presentation.
